title: 分级 · 四级｜文化与生活说明 · 60 句
description: 节令习惯、手艺、城乡变化、公共设施、文化传播和交流；练习四级层次的说明与翻译表达。

items.zh: 这个节日的公历日期每年会变化，因为它按农历计算。
items.en: The festival falls on a different Gregorian date each year because it follows the lunar calendar.
answers: The festival falls on a different Gregorian date each year because it follows the lunar calendar.
items.notes: fall on：落在某日；lunar calendar：农历。

items.zh: 对许多离乡工作的人来说，团聚需要提前安排长途旅行。
items.en: For many people working away from home, a reunion requires advance travel planning.
answers: For many people working away from home, a reunion requires advance travel planning.
items.notes: working away from home 修饰 people；reunion：团聚。

items.zh: 当地人通过准备特定食物来迎接季节变化。
items.en: Local people mark the change of season by preparing particular foods.
answers: Local people mark the change of season by preparing particular foods.
items.notes: mark：纪念、标志；by doing：通过做。

items.zh: 传统活动的具体形式，即使在邻近村庄之间也可能不同。
items.en: The details of a traditional celebration may vary even between neighbouring villages.
answers: The details of a traditional celebration may vary even between neighbouring villages.
items.notes: vary：不同；even 强调差异范围。

items.zh: 有些家庭保留旧习惯，同时也创造适合自己的新仪式。
items.en: Some families preserve old customs while creating new rituals of their own.
answers: Some families preserve old customs while creating new rituals of their own.
items.notes: while 表并存；of their own：属于自己的。

items.zh: 集市不仅是购物地点，也是亲友见面的场所。
items.en: The fair serves as a meeting place for friends and relatives as well as a market.
answers: The fair serves as a meeting place for friends and relatives as well as a market.
items.notes: serve as：充当；as well as 补充功能。

items.zh: 随着年轻人外出求学，某些庆祝活动改到了周末举行。
items.en: As young people leave for education, some celebrations are moved to weekends.
answers: As young people leave for education, some celebrations are moved to weekends.
items.notes: as 表背景变化；be moved to：被改到。

items.zh: 节日食物的意义往往超出味道本身。
items.en: Festival dishes often carry meanings beyond their flavour.
answers: Festival dishes often carry meanings beyond their flavour.
items.notes: carry meanings：承载意义；beyond：超出。

items.zh: 游客若提前了解礼俗，就更容易以尊重的方式参与。
items.en: Visitors who learn about local customs beforehand can participate more respectfully.
answers: Visitors who learn about local customs beforehand can participate more respectfully.
items.notes: beforehand：事先；who 从句说明参与条件。

items.zh: 一项习俗可以保留象征意义，即使它的实际用途已经改变。
items.en: A custom can retain its symbolic meaning even after its practical purpose has changed.
answers: A custom can retain its symbolic meaning even after its practical purpose has changed.
items.notes: retain：保留；even after 表让步性时间关系。

items.zh: 学徒先观察师傅如何选材，再练习最基本的步骤。
items.en: Apprentices observe how the master selects materials before practising the basic steps.
answers: Apprentices observe how the master selects materials before practising the basic steps.
items.notes: apprentice：学徒；how 从句说明观察内容。

items.zh: 染色之前，布料需要充分清洗，以免颜色分布不均。
items.en: The cloth must be washed thoroughly before dyeing to prevent uneven colour.
answers: The cloth must be washed thoroughly before dyeing to prevent uneven colour.
items.notes: thoroughly：充分地；to prevent：为了避免。

items.zh: 这位工匠根据竹子的粗细决定它适合做什么。
items.en: The craftsperson decides how to use bamboo according to its thickness.
answers: The craftsperson decides how to use bamboo according to its thickness.
items.notes: according to：依据；thickness：粗细、厚度。

items.zh: 手工纸表面的细微差别，来自纤维在水中的分布。
items.en: Small differences in handmade paper arise from the distribution of fibres in water.
answers: Small differences in handmade paper arise from the distribution of fibres in water.
items.notes: arise from：来自；fibre：纤维。

items.zh: 机器可以加快某些步骤，却未必能完成所有细节。
items.en: Machines can speed up certain stages without necessarily handling every detail.
answers: Machines can speed up certain stages without necessarily handling every detail.
items.notes: without necessarily：但未必；stage：步骤。

items.zh: 传统图案常被用于新产品，以适应今天的生活方式。
items.en: Traditional patterns are often applied to new products to suit modern lifestyles.
answers: Traditional patterns are often applied to new products to suit modern lifestyles.
items.notes: be applied to：被用于；to suit 表目的。

items.zh: 制作时间较长，使小批量手工作品难以与廉价商品比价。
items.en: Lengthy production makes small batches of handmade work difficult to compare with cheap goods on price.
answers: Lengthy production makes small batches of handmade work difficult to compare with cheap goods on price.
items.notes: make ... difficult to：使……难以；on price：在价格上。

items.zh: 这家工作室让参观者尝试一道工序，而不是只观看成品。
items.en: The workshop lets visitors try one stage instead of merely viewing finished pieces.
answers: The workshop lets visitors try one stage instead of merely viewing finished pieces.
items.notes: let someone do；instead of doing：代替仅仅做某事。

items.zh: 为了避免材料浪费，初学者先用边角料练习。
items.en: Beginners practise with offcuts to avoid wasting material.
answers: Beginners practise with offcuts to avoid wasting material.
items.notes: offcut：边角料；avoid doing：避免做。

items.zh: 能讲清制作方法，与能稳定地做出成品并不是一回事。
items.en: Explaining a technique is different from producing consistent results with it.
answers: Explaining a technique is different from producing consistent results with it.
items.notes: 动名词对照理论说明与实际操作。

items.zh: 旧粮仓改成了阅读空间，仍保留着部分原来的结构。
items.en: The former granary has become a reading space while retaining parts of its original structure.
answers: The former granary has become a reading space while retaining parts of its original structure.
items.notes: former：以前的；retain：保留。

items.zh: 村里的快递点也帮助不会使用网购平台的人寄送物品。
items.en: The village parcel centre also helps people unfamiliar with online shopping platforms send items.
answers: The village parcel centre also helps people unfamiliar with online shopping platforms send items.
items.notes: unfamiliar with：不熟悉；help someone do。

items.zh: 新桥缩短了到镇上的路程，但并未增加公交班次。
items.en: The new bridge shortened the journey to town without increasing bus frequency.
answers: The new bridge shortened the journey to town without increasing bus frequency.
items.notes: without doing 区分道路改进与服务供给。

items.zh: 一些年轻人回乡创业，同时继续为城里的客户工作。
items.en: Some young adults start businesses in their home villages while continuing to serve urban clients.
answers: Some young adults start businesses in their home villages while continuing to serve urban clients.
items.notes: while continuing：同时继续；client：客户。

items.zh: 河边的早市保留了面对面讨价还价的习惯。
items.en: The riverside morning market retains the practice of bargaining face to face.
answers: The riverside morning market retains the practice of bargaining face to face.
items.notes: the practice of doing：做某事的惯例；bargain：讨价还价。

items.zh: 旧住宅的改造需要考虑居民在施工期间住在哪里。
items.en: Renovating older homes requires consideration of where residents will live during the work.
answers: Renovating older homes requires consideration of where residents will live during the work.
items.notes: renovating 作主语；where 引导需要考虑的问题。

items.zh: 流动商店为距离固定商店较远的居民提供便利。
items.en: Mobile shops serve residents who live far from permanent stores.
answers: Mobile shops serve residents who live far from permanent stores.
items.notes: mobile：流动的；permanent：固定的。

items.zh: 新的步行路线连接了过去被公路隔开的两片社区。
items.en: The new walking route connects neighbourhoods previously divided by a road.
answers: The new walking route connects neighbourhoods previously divided by a road.
items.notes: previously divided 过去分词短语限定社区。

items.zh: 一些旧街名记录了早已消失的行业。
items.en: Some old street names preserve memories of trades that have long disappeared.
answers: Some old street names preserve memories of trades that have long disappeared.
items.notes: trade 在此指行业；have long disappeared：早已消失。

items.zh: 社区公告既在线发布，也保留纸质版本供路过的人查看。
items.en: Community notices appear online and on paper for people passing by.
answers: Community notices appear online and on paper for people passing by.
items.notes: passing by 修饰 people；两种发布方式并存。

items.zh: 文化中心把不同年龄的课程安排在不同的时段。
items.en: The cultural centre schedules classes for different age groups at separate times.
answers: The cultural centre schedules classes for different age groups at separate times.
items.notes: schedule：安排；age group：年龄组。

items.zh: 自助借书机减少了排队，但工作人员仍需要帮助初次使用者。
items.en: Self-service lending machines reduce queues, though first-time users still need staff assistance.
answers: Self-service lending machines reduce queues, though first-time users still need staff assistance.
items.notes: though 补充技术应用所需的人力支持。

items.zh: 这条绿道每隔一段距离就有饮水点。
items.en: Drinking-water points are provided at intervals along the greenway.
answers: Drinking-water points are provided at intervals along the greenway.
items.notes: at intervals：每隔一段距离；greenway：绿道。

items.zh: 社区运动场在上课时供学校使用，其他时段向居民开放。
items.en: The community sports ground serves the school during lessons and residents at other times.
answers: The community sports ground serves the school during lessons and residents at other times.
items.notes: at other times：其他时段；并列省略相同动词。

items.zh: 讲解器可以调节语速，方便不同需求的参观者。
items.en: The audio guide offers adjustable speech speed for visitors with different needs.
answers: The audio guide offers adjustable speech speed for visitors with different needs.
items.notes: adjustable：可调的；audio guide：语音讲解器。

items.zh: 新指示牌同时使用文字和图形，帮助不熟悉当地语言的人。
items.en: The new signs combine text and symbols to assist people unfamiliar with the local language.
answers: The new signs combine text and symbols to assist people unfamiliar with the local language.
items.notes: combine：结合；to assist 表目的。

items.zh: 雨天时，市场内的公共座椅成了临时休息处。
items.en: On rainy days, the market's public seating becomes a temporary resting place.
answers: On rainy days, the market's public seating becomes a temporary resting place.
items.notes: public seating：公共座椅；temporary：临时的。

items.zh: 预约诊室与候诊区分开设置，有助于保护谈话的私密性。
items.en: Separating consultation rooms from waiting areas helps protect the privacy of conversations.
answers: Separating consultation rooms from waiting areas helps protect the privacy of conversations.
items.notes: separate A from B；privacy：私密性。

items.zh: 社区工具库按借用次数登记，而不是把每件工具分给个人。
items.en: The community tool library records loans rather than assigning each tool to an individual.
answers: The community tool library records loans rather than assigning each tool to an individual.
items.notes: loan 在此指借用记录；rather than 区分共享与分配。

items.zh: 公共厕所的标志应在入口关闭时显示替代地点。
items.en: Public toilet signs should indicate alternative facilities when the entrance is closed.
answers: Public toilet signs should indicate alternative facilities when the entrance is closed.
items.notes: indicate：标明；alternative facilities：替代设施。

items.zh: 双语展签可以帮助读者比较同一概念的不同表达。
items.en: Bilingual exhibition labels help readers compare expressions of the same concept.
answers: Bilingual exhibition labels help readers compare expressions of the same concept.
items.notes: bilingual：双语的；concept：概念。

items.zh: 口述故事被整理成文字后，语气和停顿可能难以保留。
items.en: When oral stories are written down, tone and pauses may be difficult to preserve.
answers: When oral stories are written down, tone and pauses may be difficult to preserve.
items.notes: be written down：被记录；preserve：保留。

items.zh: 地方出版社有时专门记录大市场不感兴趣的题材。
items.en: Local publishers sometimes document subjects with little appeal to the mass market.
answers: Local publishers sometimes document subjects with little appeal to the mass market.
items.notes: appeal to：吸引力；mass market：大众市场。

items.zh: 插图能够帮助儿童理解背景，却不能代替所有文字。
items.en: Illustrations can help children understand the setting without replacing all the text.
answers: Illustrations can help children understand the setting without replacing all the text.
items.notes: setting：背景；without doing 限定插图功能。

items.zh: 一本书被译成多种语言以后，也可能出现不同的封面设计。
items.en: A book translated into several languages may appear with different cover designs.
answers: A book translated into several languages may appear with different cover designs.
items.notes: translated into 过去分词作定语。

items.zh: 阅读小组允许成员带来不同版本，以比较翻译选择。
items.en: The reading group welcomes different editions so members can compare translation choices.
answers: The reading group welcomes different editions so members can compare translation choices.
items.notes: so 引出携带不同版本的目的。

items.zh: 故事在代代相传时，可能逐渐加入新的细节。
items.en: Stories may acquire new details as they pass from one generation to the next.
answers: Stories may acquire new details as they pass from one generation to the next.
items.notes: acquire：获得；from one generation to the next：代代相传。

items.zh: 这份刊物把作者的介绍放在作品之后，让读者先关注文本。
items.en: The publication places author profiles after the work so readers focus on the text first.
answers: The publication places author profiles after the work so readers focus on the text first.
items.notes: author profile：作者介绍；so 表目的。

items.zh: 音频版本可以方便通勤者，但涉及图表的内容仍需另行呈现。
items.en: Audio versions suit commuters, but charts still require a separate form of presentation.
answers: Audio versions suit commuters, but charts still require a separate form of presentation.
items.notes: commuter：通勤者；separate presentation：另行呈现。

items.zh: 文化传播既涉及内容，也涉及人们通过什么渠道接触它。
items.en: Cultural communication concerns content and the channels through which people encounter it.
answers: Cultural communication concerns content and the channels through which people encounter it.
items.notes: through which 引导定语从句，说明接触渠道。

items.zh: 家庭寄宿让访客看到日常生活，却不能代表整个国家。
items.en: A homestay reveals everyday life without representing an entire country.
answers: A homestay reveals everyday life without representing an entire country.
items.notes: homestay：家庭寄宿；without 限定代表性。

items.zh: 旅游介绍若只强调一地的古老历史，就可能忽略那里今天正在发生的变化。
items.en: Tourism descriptions that emphasise only a place's ancient history may overlook the changes happening there today.
answers: Tourism descriptions that emphasise only a place's ancient history may overlook the changes happening there today.
items.notes: emphasise：强调；happening 修饰当前发生的变化。

items.zh: 我想了解这项活动对当地人的意义，而不只是拍照地点。
items.en: I want to understand what the activity means to local people, not merely where to photograph it.
answers: I want to understand what the activity means to local people, not merely where to photograph it.
items.notes: what 与 where 引导不同的信息需求。

items.zh: 不同地方对排队距离的习惯可能不同，观察有助于避免误会。
items.en: Queueing distances may vary between places, and observation can help prevent misunderstandings.
answers: Queueing distances may vary between places, and observation can help prevent misunderstandings.
items.notes: vary between：在……之间不同；prevent：避免。

items.zh: 在陌生环境中，解释自己的需要通常比假定对方明白更有效。
items.en: In unfamiliar settings, explaining a need is often more effective than assuming it is understood.
answers: In unfamiliar settings, explaining a need is often more effective than assuming it is understood.
items.notes: 动名词短语作比较；assume：假定。

items.zh: 游客是否感到受欢迎，也取决于日常互动而不只是景点。
items.en: Visitors' sense of welcome depends on everyday interactions as well as attractions.
answers: Visitors' sense of welcome depends on everyday interactions as well as attractions.
items.notes: sense of welcome：受到欢迎的感受；interaction：互动。

items.zh: 导览可以把同一地点的不同历史层次联系起来。
items.en: A guided tour can connect different historical layers of the same place.
answers: A guided tour can connect different historical layers of the same place.
items.notes: historical layers：不同历史层次；connect：联系。

items.zh: 提前了解拍照规则，有助于避免给当地活动带来干扰。
items.en: Learning the photography rules beforehand helps avoid disrupting local activities.
answers: Learning the photography rules beforehand helps avoid disrupting local activities.
items.notes: avoid doing：避免做；disrupt：干扰。

items.zh: 旅行结束后，回看最初的判断可能暴露自己的成见。
items.en: Reviewing initial judgements after a trip may reveal personal assumptions.
answers: Reviewing initial judgements after a trip may reveal personal assumptions.
items.notes: initial judgement：最初判断；assumption：先入之见。

items.zh: 有意义的交流需要双方都有提问的机会。
items.en: Meaningful exchange requires opportunities for questions on both sides.
answers: Meaningful exchange requires opportunities for questions on both sides.
items.notes: on both sides：双方；opportunity for：……的机会。
